title: Website Terms | G3 Qualified Engineer London
description: Terms for using G3 hot-water guidance and making a service enquiry. Appointment availability, job scope and costs are agreed separately.
answer: The website supports information and enquiries. Reading a guide or preparing an email does not create an appointment or an agreed job.

sections.heading: Information and equipment scope
paragraphs: Guides help identify cylinder types, symptoms and questions. Technical work must follow the appropriate manufacturer instructions and be performed by someone competent for the task. Information is not an on-site diagnosis or permission to alter gas, electrical or unvented safety equipment.

sections.heading: Appointments and quotations
paragraphs: Availability is discussed for the actual postcode, equipment, urgency and access. No 24-hour cover, same-day arrival or fixed tariff is promised here. Work, components, payment terms and any charges are agreed in the relevant quotation or booking communication.

sections.heading: Brand names and resources
paragraphs: Manufacturer and product names identify equipment. This independent website does not claim to be a manufacturer service department. External resources belong to their respective publishers and may change.

sections.heading: Your legal rights and job terms
paragraphs: These website terms do not exclude statutory consumer rights. Before agreeing work, request the written quotation and relevant job terms identifying the contracting business, cancellation, payment and complaints arrangements. Those terms apply to the actual job rather than a general information page.
